collisionSuffixes.-col: keep the mesh and add a static collision child with a triangle-mesh shape of the same geometry
collisionSuffixes.-convcol: as -col, with a convex polygon shape
collisionSuffixes.-colonly: remove the mesh and create a static body collision in its place
collisionSuffixes.-convcolonly: as -colonly, with convex shapes made by convex decomposition
